newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 21.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:
* King World Productions said it has signed Roseanne to host a syndicated talk show to debut in the fall of 1998.
* Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS saw its Nielsen ratings buoyed by its "The Last Don" special.
* CBS has begun filling in producers of the new shows ordered for its fall primetime schedule, which is to be presented to advertisers on Thursday.
* Cheryl Boone Isaacs has been named president of theatrical marketing for New Line Cinema, a unit of Time Warner Inc .
* Actor Chris O'Donnell's George Street Pictures, a Warner Bros.-based company, has named a production head and two projects in which he will produce and star.
* DreamWorks has optioned Frederick Busch's latest novel, "Girls," for writer-director-producer Gary David Goldberg to adapt, produce and possibly head for the studio.
